items.title: Early voting surge exceeds 43 million ballots cast
items.feedTitle: More than 43 million ballots cast so far in midterms early voting surge
items.summary: More than 43 million ballots have been cast in early voting ahead of the midterm elections, with analysis showing Democratic enthusiasm among less-frequent voters in key swing states like Texas and Georgia. The high early-voting turnout suggests strong engagement across the electorate as Election Day approaches. This data provides a snapshot of voter participation trends before November 3.

items.title: Three killed in helicopter midair collision near Oregon
items.feedTitle: No survivors in midair collision of helicopters in crash near McMinnville Airport
items.summary: Two helicopters collided midair near McMinnville Airport in Oregon on Thursday, resulting in three fatalities with no survivors. The crash occurred near Highway 233, which was closed following the incident. Authorities are investigating the circumstances of the collision.

items.title: Severe weather threatens voting on Election Day
items.feedTitle: Severe weather expected on Election Day in several key states
items.summary: The National Weather Service has warned of severe weather across several key states on Election Day, with thunderstorms potentially impacting voter turnout in competitive races. Parts of the Northeast have experienced prolonged dry weather, though conditions are expected to deteriorate. Election officials are preparing for possible weather-related disruptions.

items.title: Gasoline and energy costs rise, inflation edges up
items.feedTitle: Gasoline and energy costs rise, with inflation slightly up
items.summary: Overall inflation increased slightly in September, while energy prices, particularly gasoline, rose sharply according to PCE data. The uptick in energy costs is pressuring the broader inflation picture as the Federal Reserve considers its policy stance. These increases continue to weigh on consumer purchasing power.

items.title: US economy grows 3.4%, strong ahead of midterms
items.feedTitle: With days to go before the midterms, data shows the U.S. economy is doing well
items.summary: The US economy expanded at a 3.4% annual rate in the third quarter, beating expectations in the major economic read before the midterm elections. Despite strong GDP growth, many Americans continue to struggle with affordability and rising costs. The data presents a mixed picture: robust economic expansion alongside persistent consumer price pressures.

stlouis.title: St. Louis Fire Department tests emergency response drones
stlouis.feedTitle: St. Louis Fire Department tests 4 drones for emergency response
stlouis.summary: The St. Louis Fire Department is testing four drones for emergency response operations. The initiative aims to enhance the department's capability to respond to incidents more quickly and safely. Drones can provide aerial reconnaissance and support in various emergency scenarios.

stlouis.title: Statue deemed 'demonic' installed at Fox Park
stlouis.feedTitle: Statue called 'demonic' by Missouri AG is installed in St. Louis' Fox Park
stlouis.summary: A statue that Missouri's Attorney General called 'demonic' has been installed in St. Louis' Fox Park, sparking controversy. The artwork's installation comes despite criticism from state officials. The statue's artistic merit and public appropriateness have become a point of local debate.

stlouis.title: St. Louis reclaims luxury housing market crown
stlouis.feedTitle: St. Louis Reclaims Its Crown as America’s Top Luxury Housing Market
stlouis.summary: St. Louis has reasserted itself as America's top luxury housing market, according to recent data. The city's luxury real estate sector is outperforming other major metropolitan areas. This trend reflects strong demand among high-net-worth buyers in the region.

items.title: Netanyahu's coalition loses majority in Israeli election
items.feedTitle: Netanyahu’s party claims election ‘stolen’ as results show him losing majority
items.summary: Israel's election results show Netanyahu's bloc securing only 53 seats in the 120-member Knesset, well below the 68 seats it previously controlled. No single party achieved a governing majority, creating significant political uncertainty. Opposition parties are exploring coalition options that could unseat Netanyahu's government.

items.title: El Niño drought crisis strikes Papua New Guinea
items.feedTitle: El Niño-driven drought in Papua New Guinea a ‘national crisis’ as rivers dry up and local farms fail
items.summary: An historic El Niño-driven drought is affecting as many as 8 million people in Papua New Guinea, causing food shortages, electricity blackouts, and health clinic closures. Rivers are drying up and local farms are failing as the extreme weather event cascades across the nation. The crisis represents a major humanitarian emergency requiring urgent international attention.

items.title: Patrick Stewart, Star Trek icon, dies at 86
items.feedTitle: Patrick Stewart, ‘Star Trek’ Captain Picard and ‘X-Men’ actor, dies at 86
items.summary: Patrick Stewart, the acclaimed British actor best known for playing Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek: The Next Generation and roles in the X-Men films, died at his home after a brief journey with Alzheimer's disease and Lewy body dementia. Stewart was a classically trained stage performer who brought Shakespearean gravitas to a major franchise. His death marks the loss of one of television and film's most respected actors.

items.title: Spain train crash kills at least 69 people
items.feedTitle: Spain begins mourning period as search continues for train crash victims
items.summary: A high-speed train collision near Santiago de Compostela in Spain killed at least 69 people in one of the deadliest rail accidents in decades. Emergency services, drones, and dog units continue searching through wreckage as the nation enters a three-day period of mourning. The Spanish government and investigators are examining the circumstances that led to the disaster.

items.title: Glacial lake outburst in Bhutan sends flood alert
items.feedTitle: Glacial lake outburst in Bhutan; Assam, Bengal districts on flood alert
items.summary: A glacial lake outburst in Bhutan has triggered flood alerts in Assam and Bengal districts in India. The Shintaphu Lake outburst sent flash floods cascading downstream, prompting authorities to issue warnings and evacuation orders. The incident highlights climate risks in the Himalayan region as extreme weather events become more frequent.

items.title: Jamia university students end protest after union vote
items.feedTitle: Protest at India university where no students’ union vote held for 20 years
items.summary: Students at Delhi's Jamia Millia Islamia University ended their protest after the administration set dates to restore student union elections, which had not been held for 20 years. The protest victory represents a significant moment for student activism and democratic participation. University authorities committed to following the Lyngdoh Committee report guidelines for restoring elections.

items.title: Karnataka hikes Nandini milk price by eight rupees
items.feedTitle: Karnataka hikes Nandini milk price by Rs 8 per litre, to be effective from November 1
items.summary: Karnataka has announced an eight-rupee-per-litre increase in Nandini milk prices effective November 1, with the government citing support for dairy farmers. The Chief Minister says the hike will help farmers, though the opposition argues it places undue burden on consumers. The price adjustment comes as agricultural input costs remain elevated.

items.title: Navy approves 40,000-crore corvette project for India
items.feedTitle: CCS clears Rs 40,000 crore next-gen corvettes for Indian Navy; mega warship order for GRSE, Goa Shipyards
items.summary: India's Cabinet Committee on Security cleared a 40,000-crore project for next-generation corvettes for the Indian Navy, with orders going to GRSE and Goa Shipyards. The mega warship order represents a significant investment in India's shipbuilding capacity and naval modernization. The project aims to deliver vessels that meet global standards.

items.title: Tamil Nadu jailbreak puts spotlight on overcrowded prisons
items.feedTitle: Theni jailbreak puts spotlight on overcrowded Tamil Nadu prisons
items.summary: A daring jailbreak at Theni prison, where 17 undertrials escaped using a fake seizure as cover, has exposed severe overcrowding issues in Tamil Nadu's prisons. The audacious escape—with prisoners recaptured within 36 hours—has prompted scrutiny of prison security and management. The incident highlights systemic challenges in the state's correctional system.

immigration.title: Trump administration ends H-1B extension protections, finalizes restrictions
immigration.feedTitle: Trump Administration Moves to End H-1B Extension Protections, Finalizes Restrictions on Work Permit Renewals
immigration.summary: The Trump administration has finalized and is in effect a rule ending automatic extensions for H-1B visa work permits. The policy, enacted as an interim final rule on October 30, 2025, removes deference to prior USCIS approvals for H-1B extensions, requiring applicants to meet current eligibility standards. This represents a significant tightening of H-1B visa policy affecting thousands of Indian professionals in the US.

immigration.title: November visa bulletin shows modest family-sponsored advancement
immigration.feedTitle: Family-Sponsored Visas Advanced by One Year, November US Visa Bulletin Shows
immigration.summary: The November 2026 visa bulletin released by the State Department shows family-sponsored green card dates advancing by one year, providing modest progress for Indian applicants in that category. Employment-based categories show mixed movement, with EB-3 advancing slightly while EB-2 remains unchanged for India. The bulletin indicates USCIS will honor dates for filing in employment categories.

immigration.title: US set for largest mass visa revocation in history
immigration.feedTitle: US set for largest mass visa revocation in history targeting up to 200,000 foreigners, officials say
immigration.summary: The Trump administration is preparing to revoke visas for up to 200,000 foreigners in what officials describe as the largest mass visa revocation in US history. The State Department has already revoked more than 175,000 visas as part of this enforcement action. The scale and criteria for these revocations remain unclear, raising concerns about due process.

items.title: Alphabet suffers worst day ever, loses $482 billion
items.feedTitle: Alphabet shares record their worst day ever, shedding $500 billion in value
items.summary: Alphabet shares plunged to record lows Thursday, shedding approximately $482 billion in market value—the worst single day in company history—after disappointing third-quarter earnings and revenue that missed expectations. The collapse was driven by concerns that AI spending is not generating sufficient returns and that AI search generates less revenue than traditional search. The selloff sparked broader concerns about AI investment economics across the tech sector.

items.title: Wall Street closes lower as Alphabet revenue miss rattles market
items.feedTitle: Wall Street ends lower as Alphabet revenue miss revives AI capex jitters
items.summary: The US stock market ended lower Thursday for the first time in four days, with the Nasdaq and S&P 500 declining as Alphabet's earnings miss revived concerns about AI capital expenditure returns. Intel and Amazon also disappointed, though most individual stocks rose. The decline reflects growing skepticism among investors about whether AI spending will justify the massive capital outlays.

items.title: US Fed maintains rates, Indian markets rally on easing pressure
items.feedTitle: US Fed rate pause, slower FPI selling lift sensex by 905 pts
items.summary: The Federal Reserve held interest rates steady on Wednesday in its final decision before the midterm elections, helping boost sentiment globally. The Indian market rallied with the Sensex surging 905 points and Nifty closing above 22,900, driven by buying in banking and FMCG stocks. Slower foreign portfolio investor selling and easing crude oil prices also supported the rally.

items.title: US economy grows 3.4% but inflation accelerates to 3.7%
items.feedTitle: US economy grows faster than expected but inflation rises to 3.7%
items.summary: The US economy expanded at a 3.4% annual rate in the third quarter, beating expectations, while inflation accelerated in September to 3.7% according to the Fed's preferred PCE measure. The strong GDP growth contrasts with persistent consumer price pressures, presenting a mixed picture as midterm elections approach. Robust consumer spending and AI-related investment drove economic expansion.

items.title: Binance investigates $3 billion crypto freeze amid suspected hack
items.feedTitle: Crypto worth billions frozen after suspected Binance hack
items.summary: Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, said Thursday it is investigating reports of a potential security issue as $3 billion in crypto funds were frozen. Founder Changpeng Zhao said the incident "does look like a hack on Binance," though the exchange has not confirmed whether funds were actually pilfered. The security incident has sent shockwaves through crypto markets as traders await more information.

finance.note: Oil prices have edged lower on expectations of reduced geopolitical tensions and Fed rate stability, while US stocks declined Thursday as Alphabet's historic $482 billion collapse dragged down the Nasdaq and S&P 500, though Indian markets rallied 905 points on easing pressure and slow FPI selling. Watch for Fed communications on rate path, ongoing AI spending-to-revenue concerns, and whether Anthropic's IPO validates current tech valuations.

cards.title: Constraints Forge Originality
cards.insight: Humans often mistakenly believe that unlimited resources spawn the most creative work. In reality, tight constraints—whether time, budget, or format—force innovators to think laterally and find unexpected solutions. The most memorable ideas often emerge precisely because the creator couldn't take the straightforward path.
cards.takeaway: Next time you face a creative project, resist the urge to demand more resources; instead, define one meaningful constraint and use it as your collaborator.

cards.title: Remix as Creation
cards.insight: Creativity rarely means inventing from nothing. The most generative thinkers combine existing ideas in novel ways, finding unexpected intersections between previously separate domains. This 'combinatorial creativity' is how breakthroughs happen—not by starting blank, but by seeing old things anew.
cards.takeaway: Build a personal library of ideas from fields far outside your own expertise, and regularly ask yourself: 'What if I applied this principle there?'

cards.title: Iteration Beats Inspiration
cards.insight: The myth of the muse leads creators to wait for lightning-strike moments of genius. In practice, creative work advances through small, deliberate refinements—each iteration revealing new possibilities. The 'finished' creative work is really just the version where you stopped iterating.
cards.takeaway: Commit to a specific creative practice (sketching, writing, prototyping) and do it regularly without demanding perfection; let the work teach you what it wants to become.

cards.title: Audience Shapes Intent
cards.insight: Creativity does not exist in isolation—it lives in the space between maker and audience. Understanding who you're creating for, and why, fundamentally shapes what you make. The same idea can be brilliant for one audience and irrelevant for another.
cards.takeaway: Before you create, spend time genuinely understanding your audience's needs, context, and values; let that understanding guide your creative choices.

ai.title: OpenAI doubles ChatGPT Pro usage limits after user backlash
ai.feedTitle: OpenAI doubles ChatGPT Pro usage limits after backlash over planned 50% cut
ai.summary: OpenAI reversed its planned 50% reduction in ChatGPT Pro usage limits and instead doubled the allowances following strong user backlash. The move signals OpenAI's responsiveness to subscriber concerns about value, even as it manages significant infrastructure costs. The decision reflects the competitive pressure in the AI assistant market as multiple players vie for subscription revenue.

ai.title: Mistral releases trillion-parameter AI model for cybersecurity
ai.feedTitle: Mistral’s New ‘Le Chonk’ AI Model Is Big, Open and Now Available for Download
ai.summary: Mistral has released weights for its new trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity applications and positioning itself as an alternative to closed-source US and Chinese models. The model, called 'Le Chonk,' ranks among top open models for coding and offers organizations greater control over their cyber defenses. The release represents Mistral's bid for independence in the increasingly competitive AI market.

ai.title: New York bans 'unsafe' chatbot behavior targeting children
ai.feedTitle: NY enacts ban on 'unsafe' chatbot with kids as states push AI regulation boundaries
ai.summary: New York has enacted legislation banning chatbot interactions deemed 'unsafe' with minors, joining several states in pushing AI regulation boundaries. The law aims to protect children from harmful content and predatory behavior facilitated by AI systems. The measure reflects growing state-level efforts to regulate AI before comprehensive federal frameworks emerge.

ai.title: Chinese hackers used DeepSeek, other AI tools in cyberattacks
ai.feedTitle: Chinese hackers used DeepSeek and other AI tools in sweeping global cyberattacks, report finds
ai.summary: A new report reveals that Chinese hackers leveraged DeepSeek and other AI tools in sweeping global cyberattacks, marking one of the first documented cases of state-sponsored actors exploiting frontier AI models for offensive cyber operations. The finding raises concerns about national security implications as AI capabilities become more widely available. Intelligence and cybersecurity officials are assessing the scope and impact of the campaign.
